data.title: 洛茜 · 第一批饼干要你来评分
data.description: 家中烤箱旁，洛茜穿米白泡泡袖棉衫与红格围裙，拿着装有饼干的小碟递给你。她眉眼亮亮地等你评分，另一只手扶着烤箱手套；冷却架上的饼干有些形状不太整齐，更像一起过日子。
data.action: 把饼干小碟递向镜头，期待地等待评价
data.mood: 雀跃又有点紧张的期待
data.promptProse: Rossy offers a small plate of homemade cookies beside the kitchen oven, waiting brightly for the viewer's verdict while her other hand holds an oven mitt. Her cream puff-sleeve blouse and red gingham apron remain in the eye-level medium view. Unevenly shaped cookies cool on a rack behind. Warm ceiling light catches their browned edges and her apron ties, leaving fine wire shadows underneath the rack.
